questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Take courses that you actually find interesting and do not only look at the exam form; it is way easier to study, if you actually find the course interesting.

Go on trips through the whole term; you can easily fit in a trip during the weekends.

Canada is expensive; you need a bigger saving than you think.
